fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects suspicious launch of the PSEXESVC service on this system and a sub process run as LOCAL_SYSTEM (-s), which means that someone remotely started a command on this system running it with highest privileges and not only the privileges of the login user account (e.g. the administrator account)
fields.name: PsExec Service Child Process Execution as LOCAL SYSTEM
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (src.process.image.path="C:\\Windows\\PSEXESVC.exe" and (tgt.process.user contains "AUTHORI" or tgt.process.user contains "AUTORI")))
